name: NETWORKDAYS
description: NETWORKDAYS counts the number of working days between two dates, inclusive of both endpoints, skipping Saturdays and Sundays and optionally a list of holidays.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The first date of the period.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The last date of the period. Both start and end dates are counted.

parameters.name: holidays
parameters.description: Optional range or array of dates to exclude as non-working days.

basicExample.explanation: January 2024 has 31 days; after removing the 4 Saturdays and 4 Sundays, 23 weekdays remain. Both endpoints are included.

advancedExamples.title: Excluding a holiday
advancedExamples.scenario: Counting workdays with one mid-month holiday
advancedExamples.description: The holiday reduces the count by one
advancedExamples.explanation: Jan 15 2024 is a Monday workday, so removing it leaves 22 workdays.

advancedExamples.title: Reversed dates give a negative count
advancedExamples.description: When start is after end, the result is negative
advancedExamples.explanation: With the start later than the end, NETWORKDAYS returns the negative of the count, here -23.

howItWorks: NETWORKDAYS counts every day from start_date through end_date, subtracts Saturdays and Sundays, and then subtracts any dates found in the holidays list. Both endpoints are included in the count.

howToSteps.name: Enter the start and end dates
howToSteps.text: Supply the period boundaries as date serials.

howToSteps.name: Optionally list holidays
howToSteps.text: Pass a range or array of holiday dates to exclude.

limitations: Only Saturday and Sunday weekends are supported; use NETWORKDAYS.INTL for custom weekend days.
Both endpoints are counted, which differs from WORKDAY's behavior.
If start_date is after end_date, the result is negative.

commonErrors.cause: A non-date argument or a holiday Excel cannot read as a date.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure all date arguments are real date serials.

commonErrors.cause: The start date is later than the end date.
commonErrors.fix: Put the earlier date first (start_date, end_date).

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: NETWORKDAYS works identically in Google Sheets, including the optional holidays argument.

faq.question: Are both the start and end dates counted?
faq.answer: Yes, NETWORKDAYS includes both endpoints, unlike WORKDAY which excludes the start.

faq.question: How do I use a custom weekend?
faq.answer: Use NETWORKDAYS.INTL, which accepts a weekend code or 7-character string.

faq.question: What if start is after end?
faq.answer: The result is the negative of the workday count.
